sponsored.t: Relates to automatic license plate reader systems
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of automatic license plate reader systems or captured plate data by government entities except for certain purposes.

sponsored.t: Exempts the Liverpool Fire Department from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
sponsored.sum: Exempts the Liverpool Fire Department within the town of Salina, Onondaga county, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state pre-approved residential construction plan library
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state library of pre-approved residential construction plans which are in compliance with the uniform code and certified by climate region.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of the property/casualty insurance availability act and the authority of the New York property insurance underwriting association
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of the property/casualty insurance availability act and the authority of the New York property insurance underwriting association.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program; enables municipalities to repair immediately hazardous code violations in buildings where the owner has not undertaken such repairs in a reasonable time.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of labor create and maintain a list of available careers and job openings for veterans in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of labor create and maintain a list of available careers and job openings for veterans in the state of New York and provide such list to the department of veterans' services; requires such list to be placed on the department of veterans' services website.

sponsored.t: Establishes a women veteran's peer to peer program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a women veteran's peer to peer program.

sponsored.t: Relates to deer management permits; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of deer management permits in the northern zone of the state.

sponsored.t: Imposes standards for certain examination services
sponsored.sum: Imposes standards for certain examination services for insurance agents.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York travel insurance act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York travel insurance act" regulating the licensing and registration of limited lines travel insurance producers and travel retailers, and the sale and marketing of travel insurance and related products.

sponsored.t: Prohibits insurers from reducing disability benefits due to the actual or anticipated receipt of social security disability benefits unless certain conditions are met
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurers from reducing disability benefits due to the actual or anticipated receipt of social security disability benefits unless certain conditions are met.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance that provides coverage for accidents and illnesses of pets.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a peer support program for veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a peer support program for veterans.

sponsored.t: Extends eligibility for real property tax exemptions to certain veterans
sponsored.sum: Extends eligibility for real property tax exemptions to certain veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to suspension of a license for failure to pay a fine for impaired driving violations
sponsored.sum: Permits the suspension of a license or driving privilege for failure to answer a summons for operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs; prohibits the reduction or waiving of fines or mandatory surcharges imposed for a violation of operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

sponsored.t: Establishes the white elephant housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the large projects historic rehabilitation tax credit and the "white elephant" housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program for qualified rehabilitation expenditures totaling fifty million dollars or more with respect to a certified historic structure that has been vacant, as determined by local code enforcement or other reasonable means, for at least ten of fifteen consecutive years preceding the date of the taxpayer's application for the rehabilitation credit.

sponsored.t: Enacts the sex trafficking accountability act
sponsored.sum: Closes the patron exclusion in the definition of advancing prostitution; expands the definition of patronizing a person for prostitution to include anything of value.

sponsored.t: Requires the fee schedule for appropriate current procedural terminology and proprietary laboratory analysis codes be regularly updated for all mandatory biomarker precision medical testing coverage
sponsored.sum: Requires the fee schedule for appropriate current procedural terminology and proprietary laboratory analysis codes be established and regularly updated for all mandatory biomarker precision medical testing coverage by the department of health.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain county-tribal detention agreements between the Oneida Indian Nation and Oneida county and Madison county
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of certain county-tribal detention agreements between the Oneida Indian Nation and Oneida county and Madison county.

sponsored.t: Relates to limits on amount of flood insurance required by a mortgagee
sponsored.sum: Sets the definition of "principal" for the purposes of limits on amount of flood insurance required by a mortgagee; clarifies applicability of the state law relative to certain federal programs and requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to conciliation and non-compliance with public assistance employment; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to conciliation and non-compliance with public assistance employment.

sponsored.t: Extends the urban deer management pilot program
sponsored.sum: Extends the urban deer management pilot program for an additional three years.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum staffing levels for certain local board of elections
sponsored.sum: Requires a board of elections in a county with over ten thousand active registered voters to employ a minimum of four full-time employees which may include the commissioner and deputies if such positions are full time.

sponsored.t: Relates to risk assessment instruments for sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of validated risk assessment instruments for sex offenders to determine the risk of a repeat offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to kinds of insurance authorized; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to kinds of insurance authorized, including expenses and business income losses from acts or threats of violence, including while not on the insured's premises, and adding representations and warranties and tax interpretation insurance.

sponsored.t: Increases the interest rate for late payments due on construction contracts; repealer
sponsored.sum: Increases the interest rate for late payments due on construction contracts from one to two percent; includes a change order as part of the definition of construction contract; defines change order; repeals exceptions for lower Manhattan construction contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to voiding certain agreements conditioning the right of a subcontractor's or material supplier's right to commence a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding for breach of contract or quantum meruit
sponsored.sum: Voids agreements conditioning the right of a subcontractor's or material supplier's right to commence a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding for breach of contract or quantum meruit.

sponsored.t: Relates to pupil transportation
sponsored.sum: Provides for piggyback contracts for school transportation logistics vehicle drivers to provide pupil transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to tampering with physical evidence and obstructing governmental administration
sponsored.sum: Includes a police or peace officer turning off their body camera or deleting a body camera recording in the crime of tampering with physical evidence and obstructing governmental administration.

sponsored.t: Allows child day care providers an extension of time to make necessary changes or accommodations to their facility to meet licensing requirements
sponsored.sum: Allows child day care providers an extension of time of the original 90 day period to make necessary changes or accommodations to their facility to meet licensing requirements; grants the office of children and family services authority to grant additional extensions of time, if necessary.

sponsored.t: Requires school district representation on industrial development agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires either a school district superintendent or a representative of a school board as part of industrial development agencies.

sponsored.t: Clarifies standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems
sponsored.sum: Clarifies standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems for motor vehicle glass repair facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes supermarket wine licenses
sponsored.sum: Establishes supermarket wine licenses to sell from the licensed premises wine in sealed containers for consumption off such premises.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a civil action for deprivation of rights
sponsored.sum: Provides a civil action for deprivation of rights which is caused by any person or public entity.

sponsored.t: Establishes catastrophe savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Establishes catastrophe savings accounts as a tax-free account to allow homeowners to save money to cover qualified catastrophe expenses.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act"; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act" to replace the process for the criminal forfeiture of certain property in certain instances.

sponsored.t: Establishes the zero emission industrial trucks grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the zero-emission industrial trucks grant program to be administered by NYSERDA, to encourage the purchase and lease of zero-emission industrial trucks, class I to III.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance policies to offer full coverage for annual testing for ovarian cancer and requires certain health care providers offer annual testing for ovarian cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to offer full coverage for annual testing for ovarian cancer; requires certain health care providers offer annual testing for ovarian cancer.

sponsored.t: Ensures the safe and efficient delivery of materials for the timely construction of major renewable energy facilities in furtherance of the goals mandated by the New York state climate leadership and community
sponsored.sum: Ensures the safe and efficient delivery of materials for the timely construction of major renewable energy facilities in furtherance of the goals mandated by the New York state climate leadership and community protection act; provides that vehicles carrying materials intended for the construction of any major renewable energy facility, including oversize and superload transport vehicles, shall be permitted to travel on the thruway and state highways, on any day of the week, including Saturday and Sunday.

sponsored.t: Establishes a mandated window of five business days for both Medicaid and private insurers to respond to pre-authorization claims for testing and/or treatments made by physicians on behalf of oncology patients
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mandated window of five business days for both Medicaid and private insurers to respond to pre-authorization claims for testing and/or treatments made by physicians on behalf of oncology patients.

sponsored.t: Abolishes citizens arrests; repealer
sponsored.sum: Abolishes citizens arrests in New York state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the sex trade survivors justice and equality act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain prostitution offenses and fines relating thereto; relates to motions to vacate judgment and motions for new sentencing; relates to investigation into acts alleged to be the unauthorized practice of massage therapy by potential victims of human trafficking; prohibits the possession of reproductive or sexual health devices from being permitted in specified criminal or civil proceedings as evidence of prostitution; relates to services for exploited individuals, services for victims of human trafficking and the interagency task force on human trafficking; establishes the victims of sexual exploitation fund; makes conforming changes; repeals provisions relating to…

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of artificial intelligence for utilization review
sponsored.sum: Provides for notice requirements where an insurer authorized to write accident and health insurance in this state, a corporation organized pursuant to article forty-three of this chapter, or a health maintenance organization certified pursuant to article forty-four of the public health law uses artificial intelligence-based algorithms in the utilization review process.

sponsored.t: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters due to their increased risk for cancer and cancer-related diseases.

sponsored.t: Provides for issuing non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges
sponsored.sum: Issues non-driver identification cards to certain persons with suspended driving privileges due to a driving while intoxicated arrest.

sponsored.t: Requires certain not-for-profit corporations have a board of directors which reflects the ethnic demographics of the communities that they serve
sponsored.sum: Requires not-for-profit corporations have a board of directors which reflects the ethnic demographics of the communities that they serve to be able to receive state funds.

sponsored.t: Provides for offering reward or incentive programs
sponsored.sum: Allows for insurance providers and corporations to create and offer reward or incentive programs to eligible members.

sponsored.t: Provides for a residency program initiative to service medically underserved areas; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to develop and implement a residency program initiative to service medically underserved areas; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to payments made by school districts to charter schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to payments made by school districts to charter schools.

sponsored.t: Requires a surety bond for contractors and subcontractors where no public fund has been established for the financing of a public improvement
sponsored.sum: Requires a surety bond for contractors and subcontractors where no public fund has been established for the financing of a public improvement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of veterans' affairs to provide eligible veterans with financial assistance for purchasing, training and the upkeep of service dogs and emotional support dogs
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of veterans' affairs to provide eligible veterans with financial assistance for purchasing, training and the upkeep of service dogs and emotional support dogs.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibitions on rebating and discrimination in rates and payments under insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibitions on rebating and discrimination in rates and payments under insurance policies; provides that certain services shall not be considered to be an inducement or rebate unless the superintendent determines that the offer and sale of such services constituted the sole reason for the purchase of such insurance policy.

sponsored.t: Relates to the granting of continuing education credits by the superintendent of financial services
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing the superintendent of financial services to grant three credit hours of continuing education for a licensees' active membership in a statewide professional insurance producer association.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain requirements in insurance contracts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits an insurer or health maintenance organization from including certain requirements in insurance contracts.

sponsored.t: Establishes incapacity to consent when a person is a witness to or subject of an investigation under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Establishes incapacity to consent when a person is a witness to or subject of an investigation under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Creates esophageal cancer educational pamphlets and requires esophageal cancer testing and treatments be covered by certain insurance plans
sponsored.sum: Creates esophageal cancer educational pamphlets; requires esophageal cancer testing and treatments be covered by certain insurance plans.

sponsored.t: Establishes central depository databases for governmental real property transaction records and data
sponsored.sum: Establishes central depository databases at the state and county levels for governmental real property transaction records and data.

sponsored.t: Creates a single, streamlined process whereby combination pre-kindergarten and daycare programs may be certified to operate
sponsored.sum: Creates a single, streamlined process whereby a facility or program operating both a pre-kindergarten program and a daycare program may apply for and receive any certification, licensing, or other requirement otherwise necessary to operate a pre-kindergarten program or daycare program under the laws of the state.

sponsored.t: Provides for reimbursement for certain insurance premiums for certain members of the naval militia
sponsored.sum: Provides for reimbursement for certain insurance premiums for certain members of the naval militia.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of construction contracts
sponsored.sum: Removes residential dwelling units that must be affordable to residents at a specific income level from the definition of "construction contracts" for the purposes of certain provisions of the General Business Law.

sponsored.t: Establishes the strengthen homes program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the strengthen homes program to promote the strengthening of homes in order to protect against severe weather through remodeling grants and insurance discounts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effect of military service on child care
sponsored.sum: Provides for the review of a suitable child care plan to be presented by the petitioning parent for the period of deployment, including but not limited to, reasonable notice by deploying parent to other parent of deployment, procedures for parents to make out of court arrangements regarding custody and visitation during deployment; prohibits an order of permanent custody without deployed parent's consent; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides eligibility of certain Afghan and Iraqi immigrants for education benefits
sponsored.sum: Provides eligibility for Afghan and Iraqi special immigrants for education benefits which shall include an Afghan or Iraqi citizen or national with the status of a special immigrant under the Immigration and Nationality Act.

sponsored.t: Prohibits automobile insurers from refusing to issue or renew an individual's policy based on such individual's credit history
sponsored.sum: Prohibits automobile insurers from refusing to issue or renew an individual's policy based on such individual's credit history.

sponsored.t: Provides for requirements for approval for merger and consolidation of certain health care providers by the public health and health planning council
sponsored.sum: Provides for requirements for approval for proposals to merge, consolidate, partner, acquire through the establishment of control or proposals for any other transaction or affiliation of certain health care providers.

sponsored.t: Permits a waiver of the diligent effort requirement in limited circumstances for certain insurance coverage to be placed by licensed excess line brokers with unauthorized insurers
sponsored.sum: Permits a waiver of the diligent effort requirement in limited circumstances for certain insurance coverage to be placed by licensed excess line brokers with unauthorized insurers where a retail producing insurance broker seeks to procure or place commercial lines insurance through an unaffiliated wholesale excess line insurance broker.

sponsored.t: Prohibits corporate entities, developers, and contractors from converting single-family homes into a rental property unit
sponsored.sum: Prohibits corporate entity, real estate developer, or residential building contractor from directly or indirectly purchasing, owning, building, acquiring, or otherwise obtaining any interest in any single-family private dwelling and converting such property into residential real estate containing one rental unit.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of housing and community renewal to require certain housing quality standards inspections of Section 8 housing
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of housing and community renewal to require housing quality standards inspections of Section 8 housing when a tenant moves out or vacates.

sponsored.t: Limits the municipal sustainable energy loan program to entities which are not individuals
sponsored.sum: Limits the municipal sustainable energy loan program to commercial entities, not-for-profit organizations, or entities other than individuals.

sponsored.t: Requires a weigh-in to take place the day of a combative sports event
sponsored.sum: Requires a weigh-in of all participants shall occur on the date of a combative sports event.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain exemptions from school district real property taxes for volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Authorizes exemptions from school district real property taxes for volunteer firefighters residing in such school district.

sponsored.t: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer seizure rescue medication in schools
sponsored.sum: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer certain seizure rescue medication in schools, on school grounds and at school events; provides that such medicine may be left with a school health official to be used as needed.

sponsored.t: Requires funding for special education services and programs for preschool children with disabilities to cover full-day joint classroom instruction
sponsored.sum: Requires funding for special education services and programs for preschool children with disabilities to cover joint classroom instruction for such children with disabilities and other children for the same number of hours each day.

sponsored.t: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of veterans' services to establish a searchable database of veteran-owned businesses; requires the use of a special mark to indicate service-disabled veteran-owned businesses.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance policies to fully cover multi-marker testing related to certain patients
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to fully cover multi-marker testing related to ovarian cancer to patients which have been diagnosed with an ovarian adnexal mass.

sponsored.t: Relates to the responsibility of a landlord to remediate pest infestations
sponsored.sum: Provides that the existence of an infestation of pests in a premises occupied for dwelling purposes is a breach of the warranty of habitability, and requires a landlord to keep premises occupied for dwelling purposes free from an infestation of pests, prevent the reasonably foreseeable occurrence of such a condition and expeditiously remediate such condition and any underlying defect.

sponsored.t: Exempts veterans from the payment of certain fees relating to corporations
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans from the payment of certain fees relating to corporations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the coverage of air ambulance services in the child health plus program
sponsored.sum: Provides for the coverage of air ambulance services in the child health plus program.

sponsored.t: Provides for the return of surplus proceeds from tax lien foreclosures to a former owner
sponsored.sum: Provides for the return of surplus proceeds from tax lien foreclosures to a former owner; requires 14-day posted notice prior to the public auction of a property.

sponsored.t: Relates to funds concerning state university health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to funds concerning state university health care facilities; prohibits the use of such funds for payment of certain debts related to a state university health care facility.

sponsored.t: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines for purposes of being exempt from certain taxation
sponsored.sum: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines to be exempt from certain taxation.

sponsored.t: Relates to license requirements for natural hair styling
sponsored.sum: Provides for license requirements for natural hair styling that are distinct and separate from other practices of cosmetology.

sponsored.t: Relates to utilization review determinations
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain utilization review determinations shall be made consistent with medical and scientific evidence; includes services for mental health and substance use disorders as part of emergency services.

sponsored.t: Provides for the regulation of buy-now-pay-later lenders
sponsored.sum: Provides for the regulation of buy-now-pay-later lenders; requires such lenders to be licensed; establishes prohibited acts, limitations on loans, and consumer protections.

sponsored.t: Requires a written notification of overdraft fees charged to certain account holders
sponsored.sum: Requires financial institutions to send a written notification of overdraft fees charged to account holders every 180 days.

sponsored.t: Grants David M. Sturtz retroactive retirement service credit
sponsored.sum: Grants David M. Sturtz retroactive retirement service credit.

sponsored.t: Consolidates the licensing system for agents and brokers into a single producer license; repealer
sponsored.sum: Consolidates the licensing system for agents and brokers into a single producer license.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of an artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tool for the purpose of utilization review
sponsored.sum: Prescribes requirements and safeguards for the use of an artificial intelligence, algorithm, or other software tool for the purpose of utilization review for health and accident insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of small group for the purposes of health insurance policies and contracts; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of "small group" for purposes of health insurance policies and contracts to fifty employees or fewer; repeals provisions requiring the superintendent to conduct an impact study.

sponsored.t: Establishes a weekend child day care assistance program for New York army and air national guard members
sponsored.sum: Establishes a weekend child day care assistance program to provide for child day care at a child care provider for New York army and air national guard members on drill weekends.

sponsored.t: Extends dependent child coverage for certain individuals to age twenty-nine
sponsored.sum: Extends dependent child coverage for certain individuals to age twenty-nine.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of aerial images by insurers
sponsored.sum: Places limitations and requirements on the use of aerial images by insurers.

sponsored.t: Relates to void provisions in construction contracts
sponsored.sum: Voids provisions in construction contracts requiring retainage as expressly provided for by section seven hundred fifty-six-c of the general business law in an amount exceeding five percent of the contract sum.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 36 Chapter 654 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 5405, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to void provisions in construction contracts" APPROVED This bill would amend provisions of the General Business law to expand the list of void provisions in a contract to cover situations where retainage has exceeded five percent. Chapter 657 of the Laws of 2023 brought private construction contracts in line with state construction contracts by limiting the amount of retainage that contractors and subcontractors can hold from other subcontractors to a maximum of five percent. The legislation before me now, which takes effect immediately, will apply to an action brought to enforce or defend against the enforcement of void terms of the contract only where the contract was entered into after the effective date of Chapter 657 of the laws…

sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems for motor vehicle glass repair facilities.

As more and more vehicles are equipped with these systems, it is imperative that we address these issues. Insurance fraud in the auto glass industry leads to higher premiums and repair costs for drivers in New York. This bill eliminates incen- tives and avenues for such fraud. sponsored.t: Enacts the uniform special deposits act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the uniform special deposits act to provide for special deposits in the state of New York in a manner uniform to other jurisdictions.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance that provides coverage for accidents and illnesses of pets.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 34 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 1433-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to providing for the issuance of pet insurance" NOT APPROVED This bill would authorize the issuance of pet insurance in New York and establish a corresponding regulatory framework. However, animal insurance, which may include both domesticated and wild animals, is already authorized in the State. The bill is duplicative and would cause confusion as to which substan- tive provisions of the Insurance Law would apply. Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill. The bill is disapproved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL __________

sponsored.t: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank including injunctions and the conduct of delinquency proceedings against insurers domiciled in this state.

sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of an occupancy tax in the town of DeWitt to September 1, 2027.

sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York travel insurance act" regulating the licensing and registration of limited lines travel insurance producers and travel retailers, and the sale and marketing of travel insurance and related products.
